rows.definition: Sentinel returned by the L3 KV host registration planner when a CUDA-resident buffer lacks enabled CUDA support or any installed transport context lacks CUDA-memory capability.
rows.distinction: This is a typed registration-capability refusal, not a generic support maturity grade, allocation failure, device probe or evidence that a transport executed.

rows.definition: Caller-supplied readiness and CUDA-memory capability flags for one installed transport context, consumed across the complete context set by the L3 KV registration planner.
rows.distinction: This is transport capability metadata, not Go context.Context cancellation plumbing, model context tokens or attestation of device ownership.

rows.definition: Successful L3 KV registration-planning result containing a scalar copy of buffer metadata, semantic host-or-CUDA interface classification and installed context count.
rows.distinction: This is a metadata result only, not a SessionResidencyPlan capacity reservation, registration handle, resource lifetime or completed transfer.

rows.definition: Pure L3 KV function validating nonzero representable buffer spans, declared residency and ordinal consistency, and readiness/CUDA capability across the caller-supplied complete context set before returning a MemoryRegistrationPlan.
rows.distinction: This constructs checked registration metadata, not the passive MemoryRegistrationPlan result itself, a residency capacity plan, live memory registration or host-staging fallback. It cannot discover omitted contexts or prove physical pointer residency; the caller must supply truthful complete metadata.
